constraints.ocl:
context Customer
inv: (self.cart <> null) and (self.customerId <> null)

context Cart
inv: (self.items->any(x | x.quantity < 10) <> null) and (self.customer <> null)

context Category
inv: self.products->any(x | x.basePrice <= 100) <> null

context OrderItem
inv: self.unitPrice >= 72 and self.unitPrice <= 93

context Cart
inv: ((self.items->forAll(x | x.quantity < 10)) and (self.customer.cart.createdAt <> '')) and (not((self.items->forAll(x | x.quantity < 10)) and (self.customer.cart.createdAt <> '')))

context OrderItem
inv: (self.quantity >= 53 and self.quantity <= 80) and (self.quantity < 53)

context Category
inv: (self.products->collect(x | x.variants)->flatten()->notEmpty()) and (not(self.products->collect(x | x.variants)->flatten()->notEmpty()))

context Cart
inv: (self.items->select(x | x.quantity < 100)->size() >= 1) and (not(self.items->select(x | x.quantity < 100)->size() >= 1))

context OrderItem
inv: ((self.order <> null) and (self.quantity > 0)) and (not((self.order <> null) and (self.quantity > 0)))

context Product
inv: ((self.basePrice > 10) and (self.variants->forAll(v | v.priceDelta <= 1000))) and (not((self.basePrice > 10) and (self.variants->forAll(v | v.priceDelta <= 1000))))

context InventoryItem
inv: (self.quantity >= 76 and self.quantity <= 99) and (self.quantity < 76)

context InventoryItem
inv: (self.quantity mod 8 = 0) and (not(self.quantity mod 8 = 0))

context Customer
inv: ((self.email <> '') and (self.addresses->forAll(v | v.city <> ''))) and (not((self.email <> '') and (self.addresses->forAll(v | v.city <> ''))))

context Product
inv: ((self.basePrice <= 50) and (self.variants->forAll(v | v.priceDelta >= 10))) and (not((self.basePrice <= 50) and (self.variants->forAll(v | v.priceDelta >= 10))))

context Review
inv: (self.rating mod 2 = 0) and (not(self.rating mod 2 = 0))

context Payment
inv: (self.order <> null) and (not(self.order <> null))
